cards.back:
As a result.
Bahasa Indonesia: akibatnya
Example: The river flooded, consequently the road was closed.
cards.say: consequently. The river flooded, consequently the road was closed.

cards.back:
In spite of that.
Bahasa Indonesia: meskipun begitu
Example: The test was hard. Nonetheless, she finished it on time.
cards.say: nonetheless. The test was hard. Nonetheless, she finished it on time.

cards.back:
In the opposite way.
Bahasa Indonesia: sebaliknya
Example: Cats like to be alone. Conversely, dogs enjoy company.
cards.say: conversely. Cats like to be alone. Conversely, dogs enjoy company.

cards.back:
In addition, and more importantly.
Bahasa Indonesia: lagi pula
Example: The plan is cheap. Moreover, it is easy to carry out.
cards.say: moreover. The plan is cheap. Moreover, it is easy to carry out.

cards.back:
Used to show a clear difference.
Bahasa Indonesia: sebaliknya
Example: The north is dry. In contrast, the south is very wet.
cards.say: in contrast. The north is dry. In contrast, the south is very wet.

cards.back:
In the same way.
Bahasa Indonesia: demikian pula
Example: Wolves hunt in packs. Similarly, lions hunt together.
cards.say: similarly. Wolves hunt in packs. Similarly, lions hunt together.

cards.back:
Afterwards, at a later time.
Bahasa Indonesia: selanjutnya
Example: He lost his key and subsequently called a locksmith.
cards.say: subsequently. He lost his key and subsequently called a locksmith.

cards.back:
Before this time.
Bahasa Indonesia: sebelumnya
Example: The shop previously sold books before it opened as a cafe.
cards.say: previously. The shop previously sold books before it opened as a cafe.

cards.back:
Used to give a different choice.
Bahasa Indonesia: atau, sebagai alternatif
Example: We can take the bus. Alternatively, we could cycle.
cards.say: alternatively. We can take the bus. Alternatively, we could cycle.

cards.back:
Because of.
Bahasa Indonesia: karena
Example: The match was moved on account of the wet pitch.
cards.say: on account of. The match was moved on account of the wet pitch.

cards.back:
Even though something is true.
Bahasa Indonesia: meskipun
Example: In spite of the cold, we swam in the sea.
cards.say: in spite of. In spite of the cold, we swam in the sea.

cards.back:
Without being stopped by.
Bahasa Indonesia: walaupun
Example: Despite the rain, the parade continued down the street.
cards.say: despite. Despite the rain, the parade continued down the street.

cards.back:
Only if.
Bahasa Indonesia: asalkan
Example: You may go out as long as you wear a coat.
cards.say: as long as. You may go out as long as you wear a coat.

cards.back:
On the condition that.
Bahasa Indonesia: dengan syarat
Example: You can borrow it provided that you return it on Friday.
cards.say: provided that. You can borrow it provided that you return it on Friday.

cards.back:
At any time that.
Bahasa Indonesia: kapan pun
Example: Whenever it rains, the frogs begin to sing.
cards.say: whenever. Whenever it rains, the frogs begin to sing.

cards.back:
During the time that. A more formal form of while.
Bahasa Indonesia: sementara
Example: Whilst the water boils, chop the carrots into slices.
cards.say: whilst. Whilst the water boils, chop the carrots into slices.

cards.back:
During the time before something happens.
Bahasa Indonesia: sementara itu
Example: Dinner is not ready. In the meantime, you can read.
cards.say: in the meantime. Dinner is not ready. In the meantime, you can read.

cards.back:
Used to begin a short summary.
Bahasa Indonesia: singkatnya
Example: To sum up, the experiment showed that plants need light.
cards.say: to sum up. To sum up, the experiment showed that plants need light.

cards.back:
Used to give an example.
Bahasa Indonesia: contohnya
Example: Some birds, for instance penguins, cannot fly through the air.
cards.say: for instance. Some birds, for instance penguins, cannot fly through the air.

cards.back:
Generally, thinking of everything.
Bahasa Indonesia: secara keseluruhan
Example: On the whole, the trip was a great success.
cards.say: on the whole. On the whole, the trip was a great success.

cards.back:
Especially.
Bahasa Indonesia: terutama
Example: I like all fruit, mangoes in particular, especially in summer.
cards.say: in particular. I like all fruit, mangoes in particular, especially in summer.

cards.back:
And also.
Bahasa Indonesia: serta
Example: She plays the flute as well as the piano.
cards.say: as well as. She plays the flute as well as the piano.
